Choose renamed_to when an old entity label is replaced by a new entity name or designation. Choose failure_threshold when the sentence gives a failure, safety-floor, minimum-safe-temperature, or not-rated-below temperature for one entity. Return one relation for every sentence in the original order using the required JSON schema.
